title: On the degrees of equivariant maps from spheres to complex Stiefel manifolds
summary: We study the set of degrees of $\mathbb{Z}/m$-equivariant maps from spheres to complex Stiefel manifolds, motivated by the work of Astey--Gitler--Micha--Pastor. Under a suitable arithmetic condition, this set is determined using results of James, Atiyah--Todd, and Adams--Walker. Our approach is homotopy-theoretic.
